blockblast.title: Block Puzzle
blockblast.tagline: The pieces are decided before you start.
blockblast.noMoves: None of your pieces fit. Nothing was rigged — the pieces were set before you began.
blockblast.levelFailHint: No piece fits. Nothing was rigged — try again, free.
blockblast.unwinnableHint: A crystal got sealed off. Our fault, not yours — here is a free restart.
blockblast.dailySame: Everyone gets the exact same pieces today.
blockblast.fair1: 1. The whole sequence of pieces for this run was decided before you placed anything — by the seed below.
blockblast.fair2: 2. Dealing never reads your board, your score, whether you are near a record, or whether you paid.
blockblast.fair3: 3. The piece weights are fixed and public (small 25% / medium 55% / large 20%). No pity timer, no difficulty adjustment.
blockblast.fairVerify: Same seed = same pieces, every time. You can check.
blockblast.removeAdsDesc: No interstitials, ever. Rewards stay — you just get them instantly.
blockblast.challengeRun: Friend challenge — same pieces for everyone
blockblast.shareText: I scored {n} on this exact piece stream. Same seed, same pieces — beat me:
blockblast.optFxSub: Turn off to reduce motion & save battery
blockblast.calHint: The past 7 days are playable. Catch-up runs count scores only — no streak credit.
blockblast.pieceCryIntro: New here: some pieces carry crystals!

dexd.blue: The everyday gem of the Candy Falls. Clear its line to collect it.
dexd.pink: Loves to sit where rows and columns cross.
dexd.orange: Heavy and warm. Often found near the board edges.
dexd.green: Native to the Emerald Grove. Some arrive riding on pieces.
dexd.violet: Rides only on travelling pieces — plan its landing before you drop it.

blockblast.adPolicy: Our ad policy: zero interstitials for your first 50 games. After that, at most one every 10 games — only after a win, never mid-game, never on a loss.
